row.notes: Handler (lea at 0x14fe71e48 in 0x14fe71e00). Logs 'Received start message from %d as %s'. Stale continuation cookie -> broadcast finished (0x73). State 2: msg cookie 0 -> a sender that has a cookie sends it (msg 0x70) and opens the peer entry (0x1431053e0, +0x50 = 1); new cookie -> stored at +0x1c; different cookie -> state 1. Other states are logged and ignored. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Game_Datasync_OnSyncStartMessage (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V5734 Handles sync start message incl. sync-cookie request/host checks, not just the log. Better: Game_Datasync_HandleStartMessage
